description: Single source of truth for the SniperAI V5 feature vector. MQL5 (Features.mqh) and Python (sniper_features.py) MUST produce identical values for identical OHLCV input. Any change here requires regenerating models AND bumping contract_version in Config.mqh.
bar_indexing: chronological (index 0 = oldest). Features are evaluated on the LAST CLOSED bar only.

meta_extra_notes.primary_p_up: primary model probability of the UP class, [0,1]
meta_extra_notes.side: +1.0 for BUY candidate, -1.0 for SELL candidate

conventions.ema: ewm(span=p, adjust=False), seeded with src[0]  (NOT MT5's SMA seed)
conventions.wilder: rma[i] = (rma[i-1]*(p-1) + src[i]) / p, seeded with src[0]  == ewm(alpha=1/p, adjust=False)
conventions.atr: Wilder RMA of True Range (NOT MetaTrader's SMA-of-TR iATR)
conventions.donchian: rolling window INCLUDES the current bar
conventions.hour: fractional hour = dt.hour + dt.minute/60.0 (so 13:35 != 13:05 on M5)
conventions.macd: macd/signal/hist are multiplied by 1000 and divided by close, so they are scale-free across the 1800->4300 XAUUSD range
conventions.bar_time: bar OPEN time, in BROKER server time. Train on broker-time data or the time features are a lie.
conventions.warmup_rationale: The slowest stateful component is the Wilder RMA(50) inside atr_ratio. Its seed influence decays as 0.98^k, so a 500-bar window still carries ~4e-4 of contamination and the EA's rolling window would disagree with the trainer's full-history pass. 1000 bars puts the residual below 1e-8, i.e. under float32 resolution. This was found by tools/parity_check.py, not by reading the code.
